lookup_SPECS_for_repo_version: look up installation specs for a specific repo and version using MAP_REPO_VERSION_TO_SPECS
check_RESOLVED_status: check if a task instance resolution status is FULL, PARTIAL, or NO using ResolvedStatus enum
check_TEST_status: check if a test result status is FAILED, PASSED, SKIPPED, ERROR, or XFAIL using TestStatus enum
get_PATCH_type: get the patch type (gold, pred, test) using the PatchType enum for evaluation
get_SWEbench_instance_schema: get the SWEbenchInstance TypedDict schema with fields like repo, instance_id, base_commit, patch, and problem_statement
